name: C's Cuts
tagline: Clean fades, sharp line-ups, and barbers who take their time. Fairfield's neighborhood shop since 2010.
description: C's Cuts (C's Barber Shop) at 2240 N Texas St, Fairfield, CA. Fades, tapers, crew cuts, trims and razor line-ups. Rated 4.8 on Google. Walk-ins welcome. Call (707) 673-7601.
seoTitle: C's Cuts | Barbershop in Fairfield, CA, Fades, Tapers & Line-Ups

about.title: No rush. Just a great cut.
body: C's Cuts (you'll also see it listed as C's Barber Shop) has been cutting hair on North Texas Street since 2010. The specialties are fresh cuts, tapers, fades, crew cuts, trims and razor line-ups.

Reviewers keep saying the same thing about Chris, Christine and the crew: they take their time, pay attention to detail, and are easy to talk to. Plenty of reviews come from parents bringing their kids in too.

servicesIntro: The shop's listed specialties. Ask your barber for anything custom.

reviews.text: Woke up this morning took a quick glance in the mirror; and thought to myself "Dam C!!!! you did a great job on the haircut....Thnx Bro!!" Cya on the nxt1
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Best haircut I’ve had in my two years in Cali and I’ll definitely be here every month. I recommend this shop to anyone who wants a legit cut for a legit price (don’t forget to tip). They make sure you’re not looking in the mirror afterwards wondering why you still go to them.
reviews.author: T'Arris B.

reviews.text: Found my new go to barber in Fairfield. Chris and Christine are cool people, and all the barbers know what they’re doing. My first time I got a fresh fade from Christine. They take their time to give you the best cut for your money. Definitely recommend checking them out. Support your local Filipino shop!
reviews.author: Thomas A.

reviews.text: Just got a cut from Chris and it was honestly one of the best I’ve had. He took his time, paid attention to every detail, and the fade came out super clean. The top was shaped perfectly, and you can tell he genuinely cares about his clients. He’s down to earth, easy to talk to, and really takes pride in what he does. If you’re looking for someone who doesn’t rush and delivers high-quality work, Chris is the one.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: C’s Barbershop is great. I get my haircut by Chris. He’s a stand up guy — a great barber and friend. Always offers good conversation and takes pride in his craft. I always leave the shop feeling good about myself. My friend also gets his haircut by Chris’ wife, and she is talented as well. Affordable prices and great company has me coming back as a regular!
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: C's cuts has been my go-to place for almost 15 years for my hair cut needs. The environment is always great, and well-rounded barbers with steady hands are always hard to find, especially ones for such a great price. I truly recommend everybody to get their cuts, line ups, and fades at C's. You won't regret how great you look and feel afterward
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Chris and Christine takes their time to cut my hair. They are both very skilled barbers. Highly recommended if you want a nice clean and sharp looking haircut. Hint: go to either Chris and Christine first for your first time haircut.
reviews.author: Alexander C.

reviews.text: I’ve been coming to this place for a couple years now, and they’ve always been really kind and understanding. Before finding this place I had a really rough time finding someone who could cut my hair the way I like it, and by my surprise I found it down the street from me. 100/100 I’d recommend this place, and if you’re into a more chilled out vibe this is the place.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I have two young boys and I can be very picky on who cuts their hair. I tend to have the usual people cut their hair but unfortunately none of them were available. I decided to go where my nephew always goes, C’s Barbershop. Let me just say that I’m very impressed !! Shoutout to the talented female who cut their hair! I wish I knew her name! I will definitely be bringing them back to her :)
reviews.author: Jeanette A.
